title: Senior AI Trainer
description:
Role Title: Senior AI Trainer
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Senior AI Trainers to collaborate on a customer-driven project enhancing AI system accuracy through expert-level video annotation and data labeling. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Key Responsibilities:

• Review video footage of robotic arms executing assigned tasks, identifying key actions and outcomes with precision.

• Apply detailed grading guidelines to accurately tag and annotate events, providing structured observations that improve model performance.

• Mark precise timestamps for the start and end of key actions, transitions, and outcomes, ensuring frame-accurate segmentation of each video session.

• Verify timestamp accuracy and alignment across annotations, correcting drift or inconsistencies between labeled events and the underlying footage.

• Utilize video annotation tools and platforms to record findings and submit annotated datasets in alignment with project standards and milestones.

• Collaborate with project trainers and contributors to resolve ambiguities, refine guidelines, and ensure annotation consistency across the team.

• Participate in ongoing quality reviews, incorporating feedback to maintain rigorous annotation standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing and tagging visual data.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration, reporting, and timely updates on progress and challenges.

• Demonstrated time management and self-organization abilities for independent, remote project participation.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with a proactive approach to resolving annotation challenges.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proven experience with video annotation, data labeling, or similar data-centric annotation projects.

• Familiarity with video annotation tools and software platforms, including timeline-based interfaces for timestamping and event segmentation.

• Experience with frame-level or timecode-based annotation (e.g., marking event boundaries, working with frame rates, or reviewing footage frame by frame).

• Background in AI training, machine learning data preparation, or robotics projects (strongly preferred).

The Business Transition Senior Strategist serves as the primary wealth planning expert for high-net-worth clients and prospects, with a specialized focus on business owners and closely held entities navigating ownership transition events. This role partners closely with Wealth Management Advisors (WMAs), Commercial Relationship Managers, and Investment Banking partners to lead discovery, develop integrated wealth and business transition strategies, and support implementation across pre- and post-transaction phases.

title: Backend Engineer - Coverage Team
description:
***For that position, we only hire in Buenos Aires🇦🇷 or Sao Paulo🇧🇷***
Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.
The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.
Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.
Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.
The role
We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Coverage team.
The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee ’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work on challenging technical problems involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.
We’re open to different levels of experience. You might be a junior engineer looking for an environment where you can learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility, or a more experienced engineer ready to own problems independently and contribute to technical decisions.
What matters most to us is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to understand how systems work under the hood.
What you'll do

• Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources

• Investigate and resolve production issues

• Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems

• Work with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs

• Debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes

• Write reliable, maintainable Python code

• Contribute to technical design decisions and help improve our engineering practices

• Improve the testing, monitoring, and automation of our systems

• Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other members of the team

• Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

The scope and level of ownership will naturally depend on your experience.
What we're looking for
We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Experience with Python

• Experience with web scraping, automation, data extraction, or similar technical challenges

• A good understanding of HTTP, APIs, and client-server communication

• Some experience exploring or debugging web and/or mobile applications

• The ability and curiosity to investigate systems with limited or incomplete documentation

• A strong problem-solving mindset and an interest in understanding how things work

• The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges

• Good written and spoken English

We’re intentionally open to different experience levels, so you don’t need to tick every box. If you have strong technical foundations and enjoy solving unconventional engineering problems, we encourage you to apply.
Nice to have
Any of the following would be a plus:

• Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis

• Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms

• Familiarity with application security, encryption, and common security protocols

• Experience reverse-engineering web or mobile application behavior

We are hiring a mid-level Systems Engineer to take hands-on ownership of Infiterra ’s internal IT environment. The role combines Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, endpoint and systems management, employee IT support, access and security controls, and automation.
Your mission is to provide secure, reliable and increasingly automated corporate IT services to Infiterra employees. You will own day-to-day corporate IT operations while improving automation, identity and access management, endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes and service quality.
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to help evolve the function from largely operational support into a standardized, secure and increasingly automated internal IT service. • Keep the internal Microsoft / Azure environment and core SaaS applications running reliably, with no unplanned downtime or configuration drift.

• Keep licensing spend, permissions and integrations accurate and well documented, so there's never confusion about who owns what.

• Grow a knowledge base that resolves issues faster over time, instead of solving them from memory each time.

• Fix recurring issues at the root, so ticket volume trends down instead of repeating.

Security & Compliance Operations

• Keep access evidence, endpoint compliance, asset inventories and account lifecycle records ready to hand over for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit.

• Run IT controls reliably day to day, giving Security confidence in the operational layer without having to manage it themselves.

• A Systems Engineer with hands-on Internal IT operations experience, comfortable across Microsoft

Analyse & itération : L'idée de passer des heures dans les Business Managers Meta/TikTok pour comprendre comment créer LA prochaine créa banger doit te faire kiffer. Tu suis les métriques (Watch time, Hook Rate, ROAS, CPA) et tu pivotes en continu.

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. We're building business solutions across the enterprise at Accelerant , and we need quality engineering to scale and keep up. You'll help drive the test automation strategy and implementation across our enterprise stack: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 and Reporting. You are a key decider about what gets automated, how it gets covered, and what gets pushed back on engineering.

We need someone who can scale it, harden it, expand its reach into systems that have never had real QA coverage, and build modern, AI-assisted QA tooling that lets our team expand its impact.

You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams to identify where quality is leaking, expand automation breadth and depth, and build specialized QA agents that reduce the manual toil. You own end-to-end delivery of the test automation function.

• Sees a flaky test or a coverage gap and cannot leave it alone. Excels at iterating and shipping the right framework, not the perfect one.

• Has built with Playwright, modern CI, and AI coding assistants long enough to have strong opinions about what fits our needs.

Scale the foundational framework

• A Playwright/JavaScript framework is already built. Take it from foundational to enterprise-grade, with a focus on performance, stability, and reusability.

Expand coverage breadth and depth

• Push automation into areas that may not have any QA support today, and deepen regression coverage on core systems: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 Power Apps, D365 F&O, DCR, and Tagetik.

Implement a scalable design and review process

• Help build the design and review process that keeps automation quality high as the suite and the team grow - test design standards, code review norms, framework contribution guidelines.

Scale test execution and reporting

Host QA agents on the AI fabric

• Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

title: Director, US Market Access Strategic Evidence
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.
The Director, Strategic Evidence, will possess an understanding of US market access priorities, evidence generation, and proficiency in AI technologies. As a key member of our team, you will leverage your knowledge of market access dynamics, evidence needs and research methodologies to develop and drive evidence streams that are strategic, customer focused and optimize patient care decision-making processes.
The candidate will be responsible for collaborating with account directors and matrix partners to develop and support the execution of research projects that align with business priorities. You will coordinate with other team members in identifying and developing relationships with data vendors, strategic partners, and various market access segments in collaboration with account teams and market access stakeholders (HEOR, medical affairs, fHEOR). This role is critical in identifying appropriate RWD sources and opportunities for patient centric initiatives.
Essential Functions of the job:
Market Access Strategy Development:

• Identify access data and evidence priorities that address market dynamics, reimbursement landscapes, and regulatory environments in the life sciences sector.

• Collaborate with matrix stakeholders in working with key stakeholders, addressing segment needs, and planning for market trends influencing patient access for new and existing products.

AI Integration and Analysis:

• Understand the current and emerging AI and machine learning techniques to analyze complex datasets related to market access, healthcare economics, and patient outcomes.

• Foster cross-business collaboration, and work with external partners to leverage learnings from predictive models and algorithms used in planning for market trends that optimize market access and patient care.

• Stay abreast of advancements in AI technologies and methodologies relevant to strategic evidence generation and market access in the life sciences industry.

Strategic Evidence Generation:

• Design and execute evidence plans/tactics using fit for purpose data and real-world evidence (RWE) that support market access initiatives and demonstrate the value of therapies

• Collaborate and coordinate with other Market Access functions including MD Networks & Strategic Accounts, MA Payers & Reimbursement, Patient Services & Distribution, and MA Contracting & Pricing Strategy, and with cross functional teams within the BeiGene organization: COBA, HEOR, and Medical Affairs to inform and ensure alignment of evidence strategies for access and real-world data / evidence initiatives.

Required Education:

• BS in science degree required.

• Advanced degree (MA or PhD preferred) in life sciences, health economics, or a related field preferred.

Required Qualifications:

title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

 

What You will do:

As a Data Scientist on our experimentation team you will work with product teams across Viator to measure whether the changes they ship actually worked, defining the metrics that matter and making sure the decisions that follow are sound.

Part of your contribution is making experimentation easier for the teams you support, through reusable tooling, clear documentation and consistent practice. Viator sells experiences that travellers often book once a year, in a marketplace where supply is finite and shared, so you will be learning to navigate problems where the obvious analysis can give the wrong answer, with support from senior practitioners who have done it before.

You will:

• Design and analyse experiments end to end with the product teams you support, working directly with the Product Managers and Engineers who will act on the results.

• Turn product questions into testable hypotheses with pre-registered primary metrics, appropriate guardrails, and an honest view of what the available traffic can and cannot detect before the experiment starts.

• Define and instrument feature-level metrics, understanding how metric choice affects sensitivity, interpretation and the decision a team is trying to make.

• Investigate results properly, checking assignment integrity, exposure and data quality before conclusions are drawn, and treating a surprising result as something to diagnose rather than announce.

• Build reusable queries, tooling and templates and apply our shared protocols, so teams can run good experiments faster and with less rework.

• Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including inconclusive and negative results, with a recommendation attached rather than a table of numbers.

• Look beyond whether a change worked to why it worked, and flag when a result may not hold for other users, markets or time periods.

• Carry out analysis beyond experiments, including opportunity sizing, funnel and behavioural analysis, and observational measurement where randomisation isn't possible.

• Document hypotheses, designs, outcomes and decisions so results remain comparable and the organisation compounds what it learns.

• Grow your own depth in experimentation and causal inference, with review and mentorship from senior and principal data scientists.

 

Skills & Experience

 

• Experience: Solid experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, supporting and influencing product teams.

• Statistical & Experimentation Foundations: Sound understanding of experimentation beyond running it through a platform, including statistical power and minimum detectable effect, the difference between an inconclusive result and no effect, why peeking and post-hoc metric selection cause problems, and the common ways an experiment can be invalid.

• Technical & Modelling Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience of statistical analysis and experimentation, and some exposure to statistical modelling or machine learning techniques such as regression and classification.

HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment.  Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform. The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.

title: Head of Sales @Pelagon (backed by Hexa)
description:
WHO ARE WE?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa http://hexa.cc/, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ WHAT IS AT STAKE IN THE COMING MONTHS

- Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators.

- Deploy and sign our first paid pilots.

- Sign our first contracts.

By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows.

🎯 YOUR MISSION

- Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy.

- Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts.

- Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together.

- Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia.

- Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.

- Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country.

- Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check.

- Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers.

📈 HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

- First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed.

- 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed.

- 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped.

🤩 THIS JOB IS YOUR DREAM JOB IF:

- You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory

- You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal

- You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting

- You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2

- You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it

🙅 THIS JOB IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

- You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell

- You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement

- You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself

- Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off

- You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group

WHAT WE OFFER

- A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa

- Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE

- Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea

description:

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Lead Product Manager, Connectivity / Gateways
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Verkada's Connectivity products secure people and property in remote and edge environments. Our Cellular and Wi-Fi Gateways bring Verkada's full platform including threat detection, deterrence, and real-time visibility, anywhere it's needed. Verkada Gateways enable cameras, intercoms, access control, and sensors to be deployed in locations without stable internet or power.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own and grow Verkada's Gateway product line. In this role, your mission is twofold: make gateways the enabling layer that unlocks every unwired Verkada deployment, and build the product depth and business model that grows Gateway into a flagship product.

What You'll Do

• Own strategy and execution for Verkada's Gateway product line

• Own and expand the gateway roadmap across reliability, fleet-scale cloud management, and new connectivity options and form factors.

• Partner with product lines across Verkada (remote cameras, security trailers, transportation, intercoms, access) to deliver connectivity-as-a-service and drive ecosystem attach

• Define data plan and pricing strategy that improves both customer adoption and Verkada margin

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B networking, connectivity, embedded systems, or IoT

• Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar quantitative field. MS, PhD, or MBA optional

• Proven history of launching and scaling products and businesses. Strong customer intuition, technical depth, and ability to navigate tradeoffs are critical to success in this role.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (LTE/5G, Wi-Fi, WAN failover, SIM/carrier management), plus foundational knowledge of firmware, device bring-up, and hardware design

• Ability to build platform and recurring-revenue business models, with a structured approach to ambiguous problems like data plan pricing, carrier economics, attach-rate modeling, and ROI analysis

• Excited to roll up your sleeves and get out of the office. You'll spend time with installers, integrators, and customers deploying in unwired environments. You’ll use that insight to shape the product

Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs. Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision, and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexib

title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer, Data Science, Penguin Random House (Open to Remote
description:
Penguin Random House publishes more of the books people love than anyone else in the world and the Data Science team helps those books find their readers: recommendation systems that surface the right book for the right person, forecasting models that guide print runs and marketing spend, and AI-powered tools that support our publishing teams.

• Experience with cloud ML platforms (AWS, Databricks), model APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI), and vector databases

• Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in computer science, machine learning, or a related quantitative field

• Experience applying AI/ML to commercial problems such as demand forecasting, pricing, sales and marketing optimization, recommendation, or search

• Background in media, publishing, or other content-rich domains

title: Engineering Manager, Embedded Automotive Platforms
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve’s Embedded Automotive Platforms team builds portable, production-grade core libraries and standardized APIs at the boundary between our autonomy stack and real vehicle platforms. Its work enables Wayve software to run reliably across automotive reference platforms and runtime environments, including NVIDIA DRIVE Orin on Linux/QNX and Qualcomm platforms.

As Engineering Manager, EAP, you’ll lead and grow a US-based team responsible for foundational software used across real-world experiments and customer programmes. This is a hands-on management role: approximately 40% coding and design, and 60% leadership, coaching, and delivery through the team.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Lead, recruit, and grow an embedded-software team in the US.

- Coach engineers, support career development, and set a high bar for engineering quality.

- Own the team roadmap, turning milestones into clear objectives and delivery plans.

- Align priorities with cross-functional stakeholders and maintain accountability for schedule and quality.

- Stay hands-on through architecture, design, code review, and implementation of critical components.

- Communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs across teams and time zones.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

- Portable core libraries and SDK-style APIs for deploying Wayve autonomy software to vehicle compute.

- Reference-platform adaptation across Linux, QNX, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, and other automotive environments.

- Production-grade platform abstractions that reduce bespoke integration work.

- Safety- and quality-conscious delivery, including FuSA-certified core libraries where applicable.

- Technical and organisational foundations that allow the EAP team to scale.

- Reliable software components used by internal teams, OEM programmes, and external partners.

🙌 You should apply if:

- You have experience managing and developing software engineers while owning delivery from planning through quality.

- You have a strong embedded-systems engineering background and can remain hands-on in C++, C, or Rust.

- You have led embedded platform, core-library, or similar foundational software work.

- You have experience in automotive or another safety- and quality-conscious industry.

- You understand disciplined development practices such as ASPICE, MISRA, ISO 26262, or comparable frameworks.

- You communicate clearly and can align stakeholders across functions and locations.

Experience with Linux, QNX, build systems, AUTOSAR Adaptive, middleware/IPC, NVIDIA DRIVE, Qualcomm automotive platforms, or third-party platform delivery would be valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

title: NAND Strategist
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Step into a  highly strategic Director-level role as the company’s NAND Industry Subject Matter Expert . You will be responsible for developing and maintaining a deep, forward-looking view of the NAND industry and using that expertise to help shape the company’s  five-year NAND strategy .

Working closely with our  Sourcing organization and Business Units , you will connect external NAND industry dynamics with our product, technology, supply, cost, and growth requirements. Your perspective will help determine where the industry is heading, how supplier strategies are evolving, and what actions we should take today to secure the right technology, capacity, cost position, and supply resiliency over the next five years.

This role requires someone who has  deep credibility in the NAND industry  and can serve as the go-to expert for senior leadership on NAND technology, suppliers, economics, capacity, and market dynamics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Serve as the company’s NAND industry subject matter expert , providing a deep and differentiated perspective on NAND technology, suppliers, industry economics, supply/demand, capacity, pricing, and competitive dynamics.

• Help develop the five-year NAND strategy  in partnership with Sourcing and the Business Units, translating industry trends and supplier roadmaps into long-term technology, capacity, sourcing, and product strategies.

• Develop a forward-looking view of the NAND industry , including technology transitions, wafer and bit capacity, layer scaling, TLC/QLC adoption, cost curves, supplier investment plans, industry consolidation, and major changes in supply and demand.

• Assess NAND suppliers and their strategic direction , including technology roadmaps, manufacturing capabilities, capacity expansion, investment priorities, financial position, customer allocation strategies, and competitive behavior.

• Partner with Sourcing  to inform long-term supplier strategy, including supplier selection, diversification, capacity commitments, strategic relationships, commercial models, and negotiation strategy.

• Partner with Business Units and Product Management  to understand long-range product requirements and ensure the five-year NAND strategy aligns with anticipated customer demand, product roadmaps, performance requirements, and business growth.

• Build market and scenario models  to evaluate alternative industry and business outcomes, including changes in supply, demand, technology, pricing, capacity, and supplier behavior.

• Identify emerging opportunities and risks early , providing senior leadership with a clear view of structural changes in the NAND industry and their potential impact on the business.

• Provide executive-level insight and recommendations , distilling complex industry information into a clear view of what matters, what is changing, and what strategic actions should be considered.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Santa Clara office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Expert-level knowledge of the NAND flash memory industry  with a deep understanding of the major suppliers, technologies, manufacturing economics, capacity, technology roadmaps, and competitive landscape.

• Strong understanding of NAND industry

title: Head of Growth & Market Development

Intrinsic has grown through the quality of its work and the strength of the relationships its practitioners have built over time. That is how advisory firms at this stage almost always grow. But we have reached a point where the opportunity in front of us is larger than what organic relationship development alone can capture, and we are ready to invest in the commercial infrastructure to match.
This role exists to build and run that infrastructure. The Managing Director of Growth & Market Development is our first dedicated commercial leader, responsible for expanding the firm's pipeline, deepening our relationships with the private equity and investment banking communities, and making the practitioners around them more effective at winning work.
This is not a traditional sales role. The professionals you will be working alongside are credentialed, client-facing advisors who have built their reputations through exceptional delivery. Your job is to create the conditions in which more of their relationships convert to engagements, more opportunities move through the funnel with discipline, and the firm builds the kind of market visibility that generates inbound interest rather than just responding to it.
The mandate is both individual and organizational: you carry pipeline responsibility yourself, and you function as a force multiplier for every Director and Managing Director who is trying to grow a book of business alongside a full delivery load.

What You'll Do

• Create and expand strategic relationships with investment bankers, capital providers, and other intermediaries who sit at the center of deal flow

• Track all opportunity movement through the funnel with rigor and discipline, ensuring the firm has a real-time picture of pipeline health at all times

• Own Salesforce as the system of record for all commercial activity: pipeline reporting, relationship mapping, referral tracking, win/loss analysis, forecasting, and trip planning

Commercial Excellence and Sales Coaching
Advisory professionals at Intrinsic are excellent at the work. Not all of them are equally well-equipped for the commercial conversations that precede it. You build those capabilities across the organization.

title: Senior Data Science Engineer (Canada, EST, Remote)
description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Data Science Engineer to provide applied data science expertise within our Success Engineering team, helping customers maximize the value of MindBridge’s control points and ensembles. You will configure and tune existing models, assess their application to customer data, investigate model behaviour and results, and translate complex findings into practical solutions. Working primarily post-launch, you will partner closely with Success Engineering, Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to solve complex customer needs within MindBridge’s existing capabilities.
What You Will Do
Applied model & ensemble expertise
Maintain deep working knowledge of MindBridge's core detection methodologies: scoring logic, risk indicators, and how ensembles combine individual control points into a single output. Serve as the go-to technical resource within Success Engineering for questions about how a model or ensemble actually works.
Engineering & AI/ML liaison
Maintain an active, ongoing working relationship with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML teams to stay current on model changes, known limitations, and upcoming capability shifts. Use that relationship to bring well-informed, technically grounded context back to Product/Engineering when a configurability gap is identified, a clear technical brief on what was requested, why it isn't currently supported, and what the customer's underlying value requirement needs, not just an administrative escalation.
Configurability boundaries & value mapping
Develop and maintain authoritative understanding of how, why, and to what extent MindBridge's core models and ensembles can be configured, which parameters are flexible, which are structurally fixed, and the statistical or product reasoning behind each boundary. Map a customer's stated business value requirement onto the specific configuration options actually available, and explain in plain terms what is, and is not, achievable within the current product.
Post-launch feasibility & configuration advisory
Evaluate customer requests to add, modify, or reconfigure a control point or ensemble, and determine whether it is feasible with existing product capability and the customer's available data. Define the specific data requirements: fields, quality, volume, structure - needed to support a proposed configuration. Recommend the configuration approach that best fits the customer's control objective within supported product capability.
Explainability & customer communication
Translate model and ensemble behavior into language finance, audit, and compliance stakeholders can act on: what it measures, how it scores, and why a specific result occurred. Support customers who need to justify or defend MindBridge's outputs to their own internal or external stakeholders, a recurring requirement in audit-facing use cases.
Root-cause diagnostics
When a control point or ensemble underperforms post-launch, determine whether the cause is data quality, configuration, or a genuine product limitation, and recommend the correct fix.
Escalation & product boundary stewardship
Distinguish clearly between a configuration question and a request that requires new product capability, and route the latter through Product/Engineering governance. Do not build bespoke workarounds to cover product gaps; document and escalate them instead.
Enablement & knowledge capture
Convert recurring model and configuration questions into FAQs, decision guides, and training material for Success Engineers, Success Engineering Architects, and Delivery Services.
Bounded support to Delivery Services
Act as an internal subject-matter-expert resource for Solutions Architects and Data Engineers specifically when an implementation calls for a control point or ensemble configuration that has not been built or validated before; not for routine, previously-validated feasibility questions, which remain owned by Delivery Services.
